newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $14 mln trade deficit in June so far.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $14 mln trade deficit in June so far.

text.p: Brazil posted a trade deficit of $14 million in the first 12 days of June, reversing a small trade surplus in the first week of the month, a Finance Ministry official said.
Imports in month to June 12 totalled $2.002 billion while exports were $1.988 billion, Jose Roberto Mendonca de Barros, the ministry's economic policy secretary, told reporters.
Brazil reported a trade surplus of $69 million in June's first week, a figure which surprised some analysts.

Mauricio Cortes, the Industry and Commerce Ministry's foreign trade secretary, said some imports during that week had not been initially included because of temporary problems with a computerized registry system known as Siscomex.
